# PDF.js vendor directory

This application expects Mozilla PDF.js build assets in:

- `third_party/pdfjs/build/pdf.mjs`
- `third_party/pdfjs/build/pdf.worker.mjs`

License:
- Upstream project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- SPDX: Apache-2.0
- Place upstream `LICENSE` text in `third_party/pdfjs/licenses/LICENSE` when packaging.

> Note: In this execution environment external downloads were blocked, so assets must be populated in a connected environment.
